PC: Obtain key labs: arterial blood gas, lactate, CBC, type and screen and coagulation studies
Recognize need for transfusion, simple vs exchange
Obtain a CT head without contrast
Reassess patient, recognize obtundation and need for intubation for airway control
MK: Describe an appropriate differential diagnosis for altered mental status
Discuss role of reversal agents for anti-coagulation
SBP: Describe need for an ICU, hematology, neurology and neurosurgery consult
ICS: Demonstrate team work and communication skills by: Appointing a team leader Team leader assigns clear roles and tasks to available team members Team utilizes closed-loop communication as appropriate Team leader articulates a clear differential diagnosis Team communicates in an open and respectful manner
